mentions.name: FileMinutes
mentions.description: This macOS app provides file search, tackling long-standing shortcomings of existing search tools. Its upcoming feature lets users search inside specific folders, a capability other macOS file search tools don't offer. It was started to solve the developer's own file-searching frustrations.
mentions.problem: Searching files in macOS is a decade-old problem: none of the existing tools support what's needed, such as searching inside specific folders.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a decade old problem - searching files in macOS. Started building to solve my own issues after realising none of the tools supports what I need. Very excited about the upcoming feature that I'm releasing this week as it lets you search inside specific folders - something that is not offered by other tools
